verdict.rationale: Collaborative commenting on deployed preview and production environments is a fair question for a deployment and hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a comment or feedback feature on Workers previews or production deployments. The cited material covers Wrangler, rollbacks, observability and API tokens, none of which provides collaborator comments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
